Ravi K: Quick sync — following the postmortem, I'm consolidating DR/replay action items into one list. please add ownership + ETA here.

Sofia L: Listed the restore runbook gaps I found during the drill. I'll own the runbook updates. target EOD Thurs. @Ravi K can you add me to the playbook ops review? :white_check_mark:

Danielle M: I'll take the multi-region routing test automation. ETA: next sprint (2 weeks). Will add CI job and a healthcheck that simulates region failure.

Ken P: Backup retention audit is on my plate. Quick note: bucket IAM needs to be tightened before we change retention. proposing 2026-04-08 for checkpoint after IAM change.

Nina I: Action items I want captured: 1) Runbook refresh (Sofia) 2) Routing automation (Danielle) 3) Backup audit (Ken) 4) DR game-day schedule (ops) 5) Postmortem recurring pattern tracker (Ravi). I'll follow up with owners for SLAs.

Ravi K: Adding a short owners table here for visibility:
```
- runbook: Sofia L — 2026-03-26
- routing tests: Danielle M — 2026-04-06
- backups: Ken P — 2026-04-08
- game-day coord: ops (Nina) — propose 2026-04-14
- regression tracker: Ravi K — ongoing, first sweep 2026-03-30
```

Sofia L: @Danielle M do you need help with the traffic shaping scripts? I can share the one we used in the last dry run.

Danielle M: Yes please. If you can paste the script snippet that would speed things up. Also, can ops-bot kick off the sandbox failover test once I add the CI job?

ops-bot: sandbox-failover-test scheduled for 2026-04-07T09:00Z (pending trigger by Danielle M).

Ken P: For backups: discovered two buckets in eu-west-1 with mixed lifecycle rules. I'll open a ticket with infra and link here.

Ravi K: Thanks — please include ticket IDs in this thread. Also, let's keep the runbook PRs linked so we can A/B test the restore times after changes.

Danielle M: Pushed initial test harness branch: https://git.internal/redwood/dr-replay-tests/pull/34 (work in progress).

Sofia L: Uploaded a draft runbook to the docs repo: https://docs.redwood.io/runbooks/restore-playbook-draft.md — tagging @Nina I for a quick review.

Nina I: I'll run a 30-minute review on Thurs at 10am PT. If runbook looks good we can lock the date for the game day.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging succeeded (runbook-preview) — dpl-2026-03-24-18:02.

Ravi K: Follow-ups: everyone paste ticket/PR links here and I'll update the master action tracker. We'll do a short standup next Tues to confirm readiness.

Danielle M: Added ticket INFRA-879 and CI job link.

Ken P: Backup ticket INFRA-884 created, linking retention audit details.

Sofia L: Runbook PR opened: GH#412 — ready for reviewer assignment.

Ravi K: Great. Closing loop: Nina will schedule the game day once Sofia + Danielle confirm their PRs; Ken will validate backups before the drill. We'll use this thread for any last-minute changes. :raised_hands:
